Not the same benchmark as the jevbench-* sets of item 1: different source (raw HF dataset vs BTZSC fef2a2a), different selection (first 400 rows vs class-balanced seeded 100), different state key, instructions and option texts. Hence a separate set.

Laya compares these runs with Jev 0.91 (bench_apps.py:44-50, "AbdelStark/jev-benchmarks v0.1.0", n=100). That number was measured on jevbench-agnews100 (item 1), not on these 400 items; BENCHMARKS.md:3 says Jev was never run by Laya.
